resources.string: The hermes-android plugin is installed on this server (profile %1$s) but not enabled for %2$s. Hermes profiles are isolated, so each one turns it on separately. Ask Hermes in %1$s: it enables it for this profile, reusing the same install and server key.
Enable Hermes Android notifications for the profile %1$s. Show me the plan with hermes_android_enable_profile, and apply it when I confirm.
Once enabled, this profile uses the same server key as %1$s (project %2$s). There is nothing to upload.
Once the plugin is enabled for this profile, upload the server key here.
